Mo- compared to the Re-stainless steels. As is discussed in the earlier reference¹ these
effects are not readily explained by temperature coefficients of diffusion through a
supposed oxide film. The effect of temperature is more likely due to an alteration of
double layer structure caused by a temperature-dependent hydration of the relevant
ions and of the passive film itself, thereby affecting competitive adsorption of anions
with adsorbed oxygen of the passive film for sites on the metal surface.
